items.difficulty_reason: H2: The author proves all four parts: dualizing an exact sequence for left exactness, deriving faithfulness from ev_X being nonzero and surjective, constructing Φ and contradicting linear independence to get injectivity, and reducing (iv) to (i), (ii) and (iii).

core_obligations: for (i) uses prop:dualizable-module to get values in Mod_pfg(B), dualizes an exact sequence 0 → X → Y → Z to obtain a left-exact sequence on ω by prop:Hom-left-exact and ω(-)^{∨∨} ≅ ω(-), and derives faithfulness from X ≠ 0 ⇔ ev_X non-zero ⇔ ev_X surjective using prop:rigid-unit-simple and End_T(unit) = k
for (ii) takes a maximal ideal m of B and defines k' := B/m, so that ω ⊗_B k' is a fiber functor over k'

for (iii) builds Φ: unit^{⊕n} → iHom(X,Y) from linearly independent f_1,...,f_n and shows Φ injective, using that unit is a simple object of finite length with all composition factors unit (prop:rigid-unit-simple and §sec:semisimple) and that End_T(unit) = k
for (iv) applies (ii) with (i) to get finite length and (iii) to get a k'-linear embedding Hom_T(X,Y) ⊗_k k' ↪ Hom_{Vect_f(k')}(ω(X), ω(Y)), whose right side is finite-dimensional

compared.title: The dualizing functor on finite length modules over a local ring is the linear dual into the injective hull
compared.statement:
\label{lemma-dualizing-finite-length}
Let $(A, \mathfrak m, \kappa)$ be a Noetherian local
ring with normalized dualizing complex $\omega_A^\bullet$.
Let $E$ be an injective hull of $\kappa$. Then there exists
a functorial isomorphism
$$
R\Hom_A(N, \omega_A^\bullet) = \Hom_A(N, E)[0]
$$
for $N$ running through the finite length $A$-modules.

compared.title: Coend reconstruction from an exact faithful finite-dimensional vector-space functor
compared.statement: Let C be a k-linear abelian category with an exact faithful functor F:C→FiniteVec. Then C is locally finite, and F defines an equivalence between C and finite dimensional right comodules over Coend(F).
